Chapter 888: Chapter 23: Renowned Across the Universe (Please Subscribe)_2

Just like the Insect Race, they withdrew from the war and relinquished the first right to control the battlefield.

There was no choice; even the combined forces of eleven peak races were crushed by the Galaxy Master, whose balance scales weakened the essence of life as if it was nothing.

Now that the Insect Race has deliberately withdrawn, facing the Galaxy Master, there is even less hope of resistance. Rather than continuing to send their best to the battlefield to die, it’s better to decisively withdraw.

“Hahaha, thank you for yielding.”

Xuanyuan Supreme looked at the many Twelfth Layer Ultimates, and so did the other eight human supremes.

Since the Starry Sea Era, although human civilization generally had the upper hand in wars against different races, it has never been this easy.

A large-scale spatial war that only took ten years to finish? This was because during these ten years, the major peak race forces were preparing to deal with the Galaxy Master.

“Xuanyuan, don’t be too proud, no matter how strong the Galaxy Master is, there is still the risk of complete downfall when you strive for the ultimate level.”

“Indeed, striving for the ultimate level means even if you have a deep foundation, it still just increases the possibility. Whether you can truly elevate is still up to luck.”

…

Though the beings of Twelfth Layer Ultimate have yielded the dominance of the battlefield, they have not conceded in spirit.

For the Eleventh Layer life forms striving for the ultimate level, luck plays a significant factor when all thresholds are met.

If the Galaxy Master is unlucky, even if ten times or a hundred times stronger, could still fail in striving for the ultimate level.

“You don’t need to trouble yourselves over this.”

Xuanyuan Supreme spoke indifferently, “Please also go back and quickly finalize the territorial division with our Human Civilization.”

“Hahahaha.”

“Lin Yuan, you should have seen the expressions on those old fellows’ faces.”

In the Virtual World, Xia Qin Supreme had a pleased look, observing Lin Yuan with undeniable joy on his face.

In many past wars, the Human Civilization Alliance won quite a few, but it was the first time to make those peak races leave the battlefield in such a dispirited state.

“What a pity, such an opportunity only comes once.”

Xia Qin Supreme sighed.

“Once?”

Lin Yuan was slightly stunned.

He remembered Xia Qin Supreme mentioning, every one hundred thousand years, a gigantic-scale battlefield would open for war.

While a hundred thousand years seems long, it is nothing for the evolvers of the Ninth Layer and above.

In Lin Yuan’s own plans, it be best to comprehend the Chaos Rules before striving for the ultimate layer, so he planned to stay at Eleventh Layer for a while.

He might wait until the next gigantic-scale war starts.

“By the next gigantic-scale war, those old fellows definitely won’t let you join the battle.”

Xia Qin Supreme explained, almost predicting the outcome.

“They won’t let me join the battle?”

Lin Yuan was slightly puzzled.

“Have you join and wait to lose?”

Xia Qin Supreme shook his head, “If the result of the war is predetermined as a loss, then who would join?”

“So, before the next gigantic-scale war starts, those old fellows would definitely set new rules prohibiting you from participating.”

Xia Qin Supreme spoke slowly.

Before this gigantic-scale war started, Lin Yuan had not shown any remarkable strength, only being newly advanced to Eleventh Layer.

It was too late when he destroyed tens of thousands of Eleventh Layer beings; the war had already started, and rules cannot be changed midway.

But by the next gigantic-scale war, the major peak race forces will certainly add new rules, Lin Yuan can almost be sure, he will not be allowed to enter the battlefield.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Wars, like gambling, need to give participants a glimpse of hope to win.

If there is no hope, naturally, there will be no participants. If human civilization continues to let Lin Yuan join the gigantic-scale wars, probably no other peak race forces would join the next gigantic-scale war.

“To be able to influence the rules of a gigantic-scale war at the stage of Eleventh Layer life form, you are probably the first and last person in our universe to do so.”

Xia Qin Supreme couldn’t help but feel emotional.

At the same time, they were also grateful that Lin Yuan was an evolver of their Human Civilization.

If other pinnacle races had a life similar to Lin Yuan, he believed he would have a tough headache, not much different from those just mentioned from the Second Layer.

“By the way, Xuanyuan asked me to check with you if you have any thoughts on handling those Second Layer weapons; those old guys want to use resources to exchange the weapons back.”

Xia Qin the Supreme asked.

Not only the Insect Race Myriad Transformation Queen had this idea, other pinnacle races’ powers from the Second Layer were also preparing to exchange resources for their respective Second Layer weapons.

After all, Lin Yuan had obtained over six hundred Second Layer weapons, and a significant portion of them were suitable for the powerhouse of corresponding races. Losing a Second Layer weapon and finding a new one wasn’t that simple.

Suitability is very important.

A Second Layer ultimate who is skilled with guns, you ask him to use a sword?

It would definitely impact his strength.

“What do you think, Supreme?” Lin Yuan asked.

If possible, Lin Yuan would still prefer to assimilate this batch of ultimate weapons within the Human Civilization.

“Just trade with those old guys, my Human Civilization doesn’t have enough resources to trade with you,” Xia Qin the Supreme understood Lin Yuan’s intentions and immediately replied.

Six hundred plus ultimate weapons, what a tremendous amount of resources would be needed for such a trade? Probably only the combined strength of the other eleven pinnacle races could manage it.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Anyway, this batch of ultimate weapons originally belonged to the powers of the eleven pinnacle races.

“Alright.”

“You tell me your demands, and I’ll pass them on to those old guys.”

Xia Qin the Supreme stated.

The trade involving over six hundred ultimate weapons was instigated by the eleven pinnacle races, hence naturally, Lin Yuan could set the terms.

…

On the vast battlefield, everything that happened, especially the entrance of the Insect Race Myriad Transformation Queen, and the fact that the Galaxy Master, without utilizing any ultimate essence, merely relied on his own strength to overwhelm tens of thousands of eleventh-order powerhouses and began furiously spreading through numerous races.

Many powerful, ordinary, and even weaker race’s warriors got wind of this news.

“The Galaxy Master killed tens of thousands of eleventh order without any external help?”

“Is this eleventh order? Are you sure the Galaxy Master hasn’t become ultimate?”

“That’s impossible.”

“The intelligence should be real; the Second Layer ultimates have already given up the vast battlefield and withdrew from the war.”

“I heard that the heart and will of the Galaxy Master have already reached the Second Layer levels, Myriad Transformation Queen said so herself.”

“Heart and will? Second Layer levels? How did the Galaxy Master achieve this?”

“Yes, it’s incredibly challenging for me to enhance my heart and will even slightly, and he directly reached the Second Layer levels?”

…

Crazy.

The countless lives in the universe, including those from secluded secret realms with unique life forms, heard this news instantly, crushing tens of thousands of eleventh orders by his own power, including some holding ultimate weapons, and his heart and will reaching the Second Layer levels.

This matter caused an even bigger sensation than the Galaxy Master stepping into the Second Layer.

After all, while there are some in the vast universe who are at the Second Layer ultimate, a transformation like the Galaxy Master was unheard of by many strong entities.

“How old is the Galaxy Master?”

“Under a thousand years old.”

“Under a thousand years old and has this capability, could the Galaxy Master really be disguising as a Second Layer ultimate?”

“Right, I think so too, could it be that the Second Layer ultimate is fooling us?”

“Are you guys stupid? If the Galaxy Master were really a Second Layer ultimate, would he be allowed into the vast battlefield? Could other Second Layer ultimates watch as their powerhouses get slaughtered?”

…

In the vast universe, billions of races, countless lives are discussing the Galaxy Master. Although there are doubts, the Second Layer ultimates have voluntarily relinquished control of the battlefield, so the intelligence about the Galaxy Master should be genuine.

If Lin Yuan stepping into the Eleventh Order originally made him renowned across the universe, letting the Starry Sky Races know of such an unprecedented genius who entered Eleventh Order at five hundred years old.

Then now, what happened on the vast battlefield has made Lin Yuan’s name resound across the universe.
